policy: Prices are checked Zillow page snapshots, not a live feed or historical story-year values.
Use a verified property-level asking price or published Zestimate. When only rents are available, use explicitly labeled monthly advertised rents for the matching property or available units.

Available-unit rents are representative building listings, not an identification of a fictional character’s unit. Show a range or from-price when supported. Preserve concessions, eligibility restrictions and other material source notes.
Keep amount kind, primary-source URL, real filming-property address and check date available in the interface. Indexed pages may predate the check date; no price-update date is inferred.
Conflicting estimates, wrong-address/unit substitutions, historical prices, taxes and vacant-land asking prices are omitted.

Attach linked-property values to existing character-home map pins, including editorial story placements, while clearly identifying the filming property in price details. Never relocate a story marker to fit a price. Homes without a story point retain their values in the information pane.
